thread:
Alex Chen: Quick heads-up — I opened a docs PR to consolidate region availability + data residency notes. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 :wave:
Priya Nair: Nice, thanks. What pages did you edit?
Alex Chen: Updated /platform/regions.md with supported regions table, added a new callout in /private/data-residency.md for Dedicated/Private, and a short migration guide for EU customers.
Sam Rodriguez: Can you add a short SDK snippet? customers keep asking how to pin region in the client.
Alex Chen: Yup — added Node + Python examples. Example in thread: ```js
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, region: 'eu-west-1' })
```
```py
client = Redwood(api_key=os.getenv('RW_KEY'), region='eu-west-1')
```
Lina Park: Heads-up: wording needs to make it explicit that data residency guarantees apply only to requests routed to regional Dedicated/Private endpoints, not to hosted multiregional tier.
Alex Chen: Good point. I added this bullet under "What residency guarantees mean".
Marcos Silva: Also check the console docs: the dropdown region list doesn't match the new supported-regions table (missing ap-southeast-1). Can someone fix the link in console docs?
Alex Chen: Filed a console docs issue and added a TODO in the PR.
Docsbot: PR 482 opened by @alexchen — reviewers requested: @priya, @julesharper. CI: docs-lint passed.
Priya Nair: @Jules Harper can you sanity-check the legal/residency wording? We need a concise sentence for contracts and SOC language.
Jules Harper: Reviewing now. Please avoid "full data isolation" phrasing; use "data residency controls" + list of constraints.
Alex Chen: Got it — swapped the phrasing and added a short FAQ entry: "Which products support data residency?" with bullets (Hosted API: no; Dedicated: yes; Private: yes).
Sam Rodriguez: Also add an example migration checklist for customers moving to EU residency — network config, key rotation, endpoint change, and a short SDK diff.
Alex Chen: Added a 5-step migration checklist and a code diff snippet showing minimal changes (endpoint + region param).
Lina Park: Can we include a short note about log retention & telemetry? ops teams ask about whether logs cross regions.
Alex Chen: Added: "Audit logs for Dedicated/Private deployments remain in-region when configured; hosted logs may be aggregated regionally." Marked as a non-normative note.
Priya Nair: Small nit — the regions table should include launch dates and status (GA/beta). Our product page sometimes calls eu-west-1 "EU (Ireland)"; keep the label consistent.
Alex Chen: Normalized labels to the console names and added status column.
Docsbot: @alexchen requested changes in PR 482 — review comments from @priya, @julesharper applied.
Jules Harper: LGTM from Legal after wording tweaks. Not signing contracts here, but wording is safe.
Priya Nair: I'll do a quick pass on examples and wording. If all good, we can merge and ship a short release note for customers.
Sam Rodriguez: Ping me after merge — I want to update the SDK README and changelog.
Alex Chen: Thanks all. Plan: merge tomorrow morning if no more blockers. Tagging follow-ups: @marcos to sync console list, @lina to verify log note, @sam to update SDK README after merge. :rocket:
Lina Park: I'll verify the log note against infra config and post a short update here.
Marcos Silva: I'll open a console patch PR to sync the dropdown to the table.
Alex Chen: Perfect. Closing thread for now — will post merge commit when done. :thumbsup:
